sec: Type II receptors, nuclear receptor signalling and PPAR agonists · p833

items.q: The active form of vitamin D that activates the VDR is ___.
items.exp: Calcitriol, 1,25(OH)2D3, is the active form of vitamin D that activates the VDR. (Book p833)

items.q: The vitamin D receptor heterodimerizes with which partner before binding DNA?
items.exp: VDR heterodimerizes with RXR, then the heterodimer binds VDREs to regulate target genes. (Book p833)

items.q: The VDR–RXR heterodimer binds which DNA element?
items.exp: The heterodimer binds vitamin D response elements (VDREs). (Book p833)

items.q: ‘The unliganded thyroid receptor is bound to a co-repressor; T3 binding dissociates the co-repressor and recruits a co-activator.’
opts: False — the receptor needs no co-factor
items.exp: TR is held by CoR until T3 binds, dissociating CoR and recruiting CoA on the TRE to start transcription. (Book p833)

items.q: Which receptor signals as a HOMOdimer rather than a heterodimer?
items.exp: Steroid receptors are homodimers; TR, VDR, RAR and PPAR are heterodimers. (Book p833)

items.q: Orphan nuclear receptors are characterised by:
opts: No ligands; constitutive activator or repressor binding
items.exp: Orphan receptors have no ligands and show constitutive activator or repressor binding. (Book p833)

items.q: SF1 and DAX1 (orphan receptors) are required for the development of:
items.exp: SF1 and DAX1 are required for development of gonadotrophs and the adrenal cortex. (Book p833)

items.q: A defect in HNF4α causes which condition?
items.exp: HNF4α defect leads to MODY type 1. (Book p833)

items.q: Match the PPAR agonist — 1) PPARα  2) PPARγ  3) Dual PPAR (α & γ) … A) Pioglitazone  B) Clofibrate  C) Saroglitazar
items.exp: Clofibrate is the PPARα agonist, pioglitazone the PPARγ agonist, saroglitazar the dual agonist. (Book p833)

items.q: PPARα agonists are indicated for hypertriglyceridaemia above:
items.exp: PPARα agonists treat hypertriglyceridaemia >440 mg/dL (risk of pancreatitis). (Book p833)

opts: Salt & water retention, fractures and bladder cancer
items.exp: PPARγ agonist risks: salt & water retention, fractures, bladder cancer. (Book p833)

items.q: The drug of choice for diabetic dyslipidaemia, NAFLD and NASH is:
items.exp: Dual PPAR (α & γ) agonist saroglitazar is DOC for diabetic dyslipidaemia, NAFLD and NASH. (Book p833)

opts: False — it has no metabolic effect
True, but only in type 1 diabetes
items.exp: Note: metformin also combats insulin resistance. (Book p833)
